entities.summary: Carl Ferdinand Joseph Ritter von Oberkamp was a German Waffen-SS commander and war criminal during World War II. During his SS career, he commanded the SS Division Prinz Eugen, the SS Division Nibelungen and the V SS Mountain Corps.
